steps.name: S0 the deployed preview reports Preview, the test database (fingerprint tile...), Stripe test, the mail sink and the retailer-moves flag ON
setup: the test store auto-confirms paid bookings and keeps all (plain platform charge, so refunds carry no transfer reversal)
setup: five bookings created by the owner with operation keys (pending payment)
P-A checkout returns a Stripe test-mode session (1 booking(s), $30)
P-A the test card pays on Stripe's hosted page; the webhook marks 1 booking(s) paid, the store auto-confirms, a demo row exists for each
P-B checkout returns a Stripe test-mode session (1 booking(s), $30)
P-B the test card pays on Stripe's hosted page; the webhook marks 1 booking(s) paid, the store auto-confirms, a demo row exists for each

P-C the test card pays on Stripe's hosted page; the webhook marks 1 booking(s) paid, the store auto-confirms, a demo row exists for each
P-D checkout returns a Stripe test-mode session (2 booking(s), $60)
P-D the test card pays on Stripe's hosted page; the webhook marks 2 booking(s) paid, the store auto-confirms, a demo row exists for each
S1-1 the store moves the paid, confirmed demo to 2:00 PM the same day: booking and demo rows carry the new time and a new schedule revision; a pending move with a 72 h reconfirmation deadline
S1-2 the brand dashboard data shows the pending move on that demo

pending_move.note: Our morning staffer called in sick; can you do 2 pm instead?

steps.name: S1-3 the notification worker sends the "store moved your demo, please confirm" notice to the brand owner only
S1-4 the brand confirms the move: move confirmed, the booking stays confirmed and paid at the NEW time, no refund request, allocation untouched, no Stripe refund on the payment
S1-5 a later decline of the confirmed move is refused (409 move_confirmed) and changes nothing
S2-1 the store moves the second paid demo to 11:00 AM (pending move)

S2-2 the brand declines: the route answers declined + cancelled with the refund SUBMITTED; the move is settled with the refund request id; the booking is cancelled (reason: the brand could not make the new time) and refunded; the demo row is cancelled

respond.message: You told us you cannot make the new time, so this demo was cancelled; the full refund has been submitted to your card provider.

booking.cancel_reason: The brand could not make the new time after the store moved this demo.

refund_requests.reason: The brand could not make the new time after the store moved this demo.

steps.name: S2-3 money: exactly one refund request for the full $30.00 allocation, carrying the Stripe refund id; the allocation shows $30.00 refunded; Stripe has exactly one succeeded $30.00 refund on the payment

refund_requests.reason: The brand could not make the new time after the store moved this demo.

steps.name: S2-4 the worker sends the cancellation notice (demo_move_cancelled) to the brand owner; the earlier "please confirm" notice was sent before the decline
S2-5 a later confirm of the declined move is refused (409 move_declined) with the persisted outcome in the message; no second refund

detail.message: You told us you cannot make the new time, so this demo was cancelled; the full refund has been submitted to your card provider.

steps.name: S3-1 the store moves the third paid demo to 2:00 PM (pending move)
S3-2 the deployed refund worker lapses the overdue move and settles it in the same run (1 lapsed, 1 settled, none failed or parked)

S3-3 after the lapse: move lapsed and settled with the refund SUBMITTED; booking cancelled (reason: the brand did not reconfirm) and refunded; demo row cancelled; one $30.00 refund request; allocation $30.00 refunded; one succeeded $30.00 Stripe refund

booking.cancel_reason: The brand did not reconfirm the new time after the store moved this demo.

refund_requests.reason: The brand did not reconfirm the new time after the store moved this demo.

steps.name: S3-4 the brand's late confirm is refused (409 move_lapsed) with the persisted outcome ("window has passed", "cancelled", "refund has been submitted"); no second refund

detail.message: The reconfirmation window has passed, so this demo was cancelled; the full refund has been submitted to your card provider.

steps.name: S3-5 notices: the "please confirm" notice went to the owner before the lapse; the cancellation notice (demo_move_cancelled) goes to the owner after it
S4-1 both bookings share ONE Stripe payment of $60.00 (one payment intent, one payment group, two $30.00 allocations)
S4-2 the store moves the first of the two demos to 11:00 AM (pending move); the sibling is untouched

S4-3 the brand declines: ONLY the moved booking is cancelled and refunded (one $30.00 refund request, its allocation $30.00 refunded); the sibling stays confirmed and paid at its original time with $0 refunded and no refund request

moved.cancel_reason: The brand could not make the new time after the store moved this demo.

refund_requests_moved.reason: The brand could not make the new time after the store moved this demo.

steps.name: S4-4 Stripe: exactly one refund on the shared payment, for $30.00 of the $60.00 (never the whole payment)
S4-5 a following refund worker run leaves the shared payment alone (still one refund; no move failed or parked)
S4-6 the store later cancels the sibling: its own $30.00 refund is independent (now two $30.00 refunds on the $60.00 payment, each allocation refunded once)
S4-7 notices for the moved booking: please-confirm then cancellation, both to the owner
Z1 closing refund worker run: ok, nothing failed or parked; every move of this run is terminal (confirmed or settled) with no reconciliation, refund or notice case
